runbooks.diagnosis: Memcached is the third netns passenger of postgres (network_mode: "service:postgres", alongside pgbouncer and redis; runs `memcached -m 2048 -c 4096 -t 4` in the shared netns). A postgres recreate without a passenger recreate orphans memcached in the dead loopback-only netns, so every cache consumer on memcached:11211 gets connection refused.
remediation: docker compose up -d memcached after any postgres recreate / DB bounce
Verify the container is listening on 11211 inside the (current) postgres netns
Confirm a cache consumer performs a successful lookup
